failureReason: The model deliberately built a plain Node.js HTTP server using node:http instead of a Next.js application. All 4 runs show the same pattern: the model explicitly stated it would build a "zero-dependency Node app" and never attempted to set up Next.js. The eval test correctly identifies that no Next.js framework is present in node_modules, there is no next.config.js, no app/pages directory, and the start script runs plain Node.js instead of the Next.js CLI.
